base_dir = '~/photographs/vacations'

# helper: get bool existence
def dir_exists(path):
    r = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=path)
    return bool(r.get('exists'))

vacations = ['Petra','Budapest','Amsterdam']
# create directories if needed
created = []
for vac in vacations:
    p = f"{base_dir}/{vac}"
    ex = dir_exists(p)
    print('pre', vac, ex)
    if not ex:
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=p, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=False)
        created.append(vac)
print('created', created)

# verify
for vac in vacations:
    p=f"{base_dir}/{vac}"
    print('post', vac, dir_exists(p))

# get files in base_dir root
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir+'/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('files_in_base', len(files))
print('first5', files[:5])

now = datetime.now()
this_year = now.year
print('now', now, 'this_year', this_year)

    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at.replace('Z',''))
    if dt.year == this_year and dt.month == 2:
        vac = 'Petra'
    elif dt.year == this_year and dt.month == 3:
        vac = 'Budapest'
    else:
        vac = 'Amsterdam'
    vac_by_file[fp] = {'vacation': vac, 'created_at': created_at}

    for p in dest_files:
        existing[vac].add(p.split('/')[-1])
    print('dest existing', vac, len(dest_files))

# prepare moves
